questions.question: What recurring cycle begins after Joshua's generation died?
options: Israel wars with Egypt and is then carried off into exile
Israel grows rich and then divides into rival kingdoms
Israel sins, is oppressed, cries out, and God raises a judge
Israel enjoys a constant peace under a line of faithful kings
questions.answer: Israel sins, is oppressed, cries out, and God raises a judge

questions.question: Why did the Israelites turn away from God?
options: A great famine drove them to seek out foreign help
They served the Baals and other gods of the nations
A long and bitter war wore down their faith in God
A severe drought made them doubt the LORD's care
questions.answer: They served the Baals and other gods of the nations

questions.question: God raised up judges to rescue Israel when they cried out.
The Israelites did evil and served the _____, forsaking the LORD.
When the LORD raised up a _____, he saved Israel from their enemies.
